style.name: 午夜星轨
style.css: #root{--surface:#101b2be8;--ink:#f5f6fa;--muted:#a4b6c6;--accent:#72c8de;--edge:#ffffff36;width:100%;height:100%;padding:11px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;overflow:hidden;border-radius:9px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--edge);color:var(--ink);font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:inset 0 1px #ffffff26,0 8px 20px #0002;position:relative}#root:before{content:'';position:absolute;width:55%;aspect-ratio:1;border:1px solid var(--accent);border-radius:50%;right:-20%;bottom:-55%;opacity:.23;pointer-events:none}#root:after{content:'';position:absolute;width:38%;aspect-ratio:1;border:1px solid var(--accent);border-radius:50%;right:-12%;bottom:-38%;opacity:.35;pointer-events:none}.top,.foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;position:relative;z-index:1;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em}.mark{color:var(--accent);font-size:16px}.content{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;min-width:0;position:relative;z-index:1}.story{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-width:0}.eyebrow{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--accent);white-space:nowrap}.title{font-size:15px;line-height:1.15;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.date{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}.counter{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:2px;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--accent);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.number{font-size:27px;font-weight:750;line-height:1;letter-spacing:0}.unit{font-size:11px}.status{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.decoration{color:var(--accent);white-space:nowrap}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.mark{animation:glow 3s ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes glow{to{opacity:.45;transform:rotate(30deg)}}}#root[data-size="1x1"]{padding:7px}.top .tag{display:none}#root[data-size="1x1"] .eyebrow,#root[data-size="1x1"] .date,#root[data-size="1x1"] .decoration{display:none}#root[data-size="1x1"] .content{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:2px}#root[data-size="1x1"] .title{font-size:10px;max-width:100%}#root[data-size="1x1"] .number{font-size:24px}#root[data-size="1x1"] .status{font-size:8px}#root[data-size="1x2"] .content{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:15px}#root[data-size="1x2"] .number{font-size:39px}#root[data-size="1x2"] .title{font-size:13px}#root[data-size="1x2"] .eyebrow{display:none}#root[data-size="1x2"] .decoration{display:none}#root[data-size="1x2"] .status{font-size:9px}#root[data-size="2x1"] .eyebrow,#root[data-size="2x1"] .decoration{display:none}#root[data-size="2x1"] .number{font-size:31px}#root[data-size="2x1"] .story{max-width:56%}#root[data-size="2x2"]{padding:17px}#root[data-size="2x2"] .content{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:18px}#root[data-size="2x2"] .title{font-size:20px}#root[data-size="2x2"] .number{font-size:55px}#root[data-size="2x2"] .counter{align-self:flex-end}#root[data-size="2x2"] .unit{font-size:15px}
